## Recipe checklist

- [ ] `README.md` present with H1 title and summary paragraph
- [ ] `rule.yaml` is valid Jommit YAML (`version: '1.0'`, `automations:` array)
- [ ] `fixture-event.json` present and valid JSON
- [ ] `screenshot.png` present
- [ ] Recipe validates locally (`npm run validate -- --recipe <path>`)
- [ ] `index.json` regenerated (`npm run build:index`)
